summary: The deferred Lithos cancellation and late-response cleanup are correctly wired for both stream variants, with regression coverage.

evidence: src/provider/lithos-handlers.ts composes cancellation signals for deferred dispatches, exposes cancel, and passes it through both Chat and Responses handlers.
src/provider/stream-relay.ts cancels pending dispatches on stream cancellation and cancels late-resolving responses before frame iteration.
tests/oss-stream-lifecycle.test.ts verifies both wire variants cancel the late body exactly once without starting an upstream read.
